title: [replay] feat(desktop): ready copy shows up in the Library; minimizable export widget
body:
> **Replay of [niway-dev/kaipu-record#464](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/464)** for the code-review benchmark. Base `13b7ff5`, head `e45c845`: the same commits the original reviewers saw, so the diff is byte-identical. Never merged. Method and scoring: [wachiman/docs/benchmark](https://github.com/niway-dev/wachiman/tree/main/docs/benchmark). The original description follows.

---

## Summary

Owner QA: a GitHub copy finished and its toast appeared, but the Library gave almost no sign of the new file. This makes the result obvious, following Claude Design `Kaipu Export v3.dc.html` section 4 (`editorBusy`, `editorMini`, `libGrid`) and the "Ready to upload" card in `Kaipu Prepare.dc.html` step 4.

Stacked on #466 (`feature/floating-ready-window`), the top of #459 ← #467 ← #465 ← #466. The merge commit brings in the Export screen: the rail badge now sits on Export, and leaving the Library still retires the Ready to upload cards. No Linear ticket: the workspace hit its issue limit.

- **Email wording.** Email, now its own destination (#467), gets its own text: "Exporting for email", "Email copy ready", "Drag to an email" and a FOR EMAIL tag. Before this, the toasts said "your export" and the tag said "Archive copy".

- **Ready to upload card.** A copy that just finished leads the Library grid across two columns, in place of its regular card. It has the poster with a destination tag (FOR YOUTUBE in red, FOR GITHUB…), "✓ Ready to upload", the file name, `2560 × 1440 · 3:02 · 566 MB · from the original`, a pink **Show in Finder** and **Drag to YouTube Studio**. The drag uses the existing `startFileDrag` IPC. Other destinations say Drag to TikTok or Reels, LinkedIn, GitHub, Slack or a folder; an editor export says Drag to upload. Each finished copy gets its own card, newest first. A card stays until the copy is opened, the card is closed (✕), or the user leaves the Library.
- **Grid tags.** Copies carry their destination tag. It comes from the export job, or from the sidecar for older copies. Originals keep "Master · full quality"; editor exports and GIFs keep their kind badge.
- **Progress widget**, bottom right on every screen: "Exporting for YouTube", "38% · about 2 min left", the striped bar, "Keep working. The copy lands in your Library when it's done.", and Cancel. **−** collapses it to a pill with a progress ring ("YouTube copy · 38%"); clicking the pill opens it again. The minimized state holds for the session (`sessionStorage`). An error always shows in full.
- **Ready toast**: "YouTube copy ready", `2560 × 1440 · 566 MB · in your Library`, Show in Finder, Drag to YouTube Studio.
- **Fix found along the way.** The sidecar stores fingerprints with the encode revision (`whole#2560x1440-v1`), so "Copies from this master" never recognised YouTube, GitHub or chat copies and listed them by title. `copyDestinationOf` / `copyPresetOf` compare only the content part, and the panel now uses them.

### Design decisions
- The runner's per-export `progressHidden` / `hideExportProgress` are removed. The session-wide minimized state replaces them.
- Cards are retired when the route leaves the Library, from the rail's route hook. It is not done on page unmount, because StrictMode unmounts once on mount in development.
- Ready cards show only in grid view, and only for copies the current filters show.
- Export cards moved bottom right. A page's own card ("Recording saved") stays top right.
- Untouched (sibling branches): Library header and its drop strip, Export/Prepare screen, recording detail page, post-recording card, the "1 copy ready" chip, and the rail badge.

### Fit at 900 × 670
At the default window, the content column is about 780 px, so the ready card is about 514 px wide. The poster takes 38% (max 220 px), the buttons wrap to two rows, and the mono line wraps instead of being cut. The widget is 380 px wide, sitting 40 px above the bottom (clear of the 28 px status bar). These numbers come from the CSS, not from running the app: Electron was not launched.

### Verification
`bun run verify` is green (kaipu-record: 318 test files). New or updated tests:
- the ready card leads the grid, one card per copy (newest first), Show in Finder, drag, close, and open;
- grid tags for copies and the original;
- widget minimize, the pill expanding again, minimized state carried to the next export, and an error showing in full while minimized;
- retiring cards on leaving the Library;
- `copyDestinationOf`, including the revision fix in the panel.

Docs: `backlog/ready-copy-in-library.md` and its row in `backlog/index.mdx`.

## How to test it yourself

1. Run `bun run dev`, open the Library → a recording → Prepare → YouTube → Prepare. Bottom right shows "Exporting for YouTube" with the YouTube tile, percent and time left, a moving striped bar, the "Keep working…" line, and Cancel.
2. Click **−**. A pill "YouTube copy · N%" with a ring takes its place. Switch to the Editor or Settings: the pill stays. Click it: the widget opens again.
3. Minimize it, let the export finish, then start another one. The new export starts as the pill.
4. When an export ends, bottom right shows "YouTube copy ready", "2560 × 1440 · … MB · in your Library", Show in Finder, and Drag to YouTube Studio.
5. Open the Library. The first card spans two columns: FOR YOUTUBE tag, "✓ Ready to upload", the file name, "2560 × 1440 · m:ss · … MB · from the original". Show in Finder reveals the file. Drag **Drag to YouTube Studio** onto a browser upload page: the file drops.
6. Go to another screen and come back. The big card is gone. The copy's normal card has a red FOR YOUTUBE tag and the pink outline. The original still says "Master · full quality".
7. Make a GitHub copy and then a chat copy, and open the Library. You see two cards, newest first: FOR CHAT / Drag to Slack, then FOR GITHUB / Drag to GitHub. Click ✕ on one: its normal card comes back.
8. Open a recording's page. Under "Copies from this master", the YouTube/GitHub copies are named by destination ("YouTube 1440p", "GitHub · Jira · Linear"), not by title.
9. Repeat steps 5–7 at the default 900 × 670 window. The card's text wraps, nothing is cut off, and the widget sits above the status bar.
